items.statement: Carbon segment CPC sales volume rose substantially in Q2 2024 versus Q1 2024 and Q2 2023

items.statement: Carbon segment volume grew 20% year-over-year in Q2 2024

items.statement: Soda ash revenue pressure from oversupply and higher imports
items.quote: Revenue performance was characterized by oversupply situation in soda ash due to higher imports resulting in continued pressure on pricing.

items.statement: Targeting 15% CAGR profit growth long term
items.quote: To grow profits at a CAGR 15% on a long-term horizon

items.statement: Greenfield soda ash project 5 lakh MT phase I underway
items.quote: Greenfield Soda Ash project of 5L MT (phase I)

items.statement: Vacuum salt and bromine projects to come on stream next year
items.quote: other projects such as Vacuum Salt and Bromine are set to come on stream in next year

items.statement: Sodium bicarbonate capacity doubled to 120K MT
items.quote: We have doubled the production capacity at existing Soda Ash plant to 120K MT

items.statement: Growth capex Rs 141 crore in Q1 FY25
Net cash surplus Rs 676 crore
items.quote: Net Cash Surplus of Rs. 676 Cr.

items.statement: Cash and cash equivalents Rs 853 crore
items.quote: Closing cash & cash equivalents** Rs. 853 Cr.

items.statement: Soda ash market share 26% in India
items.quote: 2nd largest manufacturer of Soda Ash in India, with 26% market share

items.statement: Focus on salt yield improvement and backward integration
items.quote: Salt yield improvement Augmenting backward integration of raw material for enhanced control on cost

items.statement: Global soda ash oversupply with new capacity in China and US
items.quote: Soda Ash market worldwide is oversupplied and new production capacities have been built in China and US.

items.statement: Soda ash prices expected to stabilize at current level
items.quote: We expect Soda Ash prices to have nearly bottomed out and should stabilize at current level.

items.statement: Long term soda ash demand to grow to 78-83 million MT by 2030
items.quote: The long-term demand for soda ash is strong and expected to increase from 67.8 million MT to 78-83 million MT by 2030.

items.statement: Union budget 10% import duty on solar glass to benefit domestic soda ash
items.quote: Union budget has also imposed a 10% import duty on solar glass, which will facilitate the domestic soda ash industry.

items.statement: Liquid funds as on 30th June 2024 were ~₹1,027 Crores including HQLA
items.quote: As on 30th June 2024 Company has liquid funds of ~ ₹ 1,027 Crores including HQLA amount
